summary: Final integrated review found no blockers. The complete implementation satisfies the original request: Supabase replaces file persistence, SUN-only tagging with baseline/replay protection is wired through participant and admin flows, production secret guard and admin login limiting are in place, participant rejoin works, Vercel/Supabase operations are documented, and final static/browser regression evidence passed.

Inspected src/lib/auth.ts, admin login route, all API guard coverage, and admin_login_attempts migration: production configGuard blocks default/missing ADMIN_PASSWORD or APP_SECRET, login attempts are persisted and locked per IP, and successful login clears attempts.

Inspected rejoin route, join form, DB rejoin migration, and final/API evidence: rejoin sets cp_pid only for exact session/team/normalized-name matches, duplicate normalized team names are DB-enforced, and pending SUN after rejoin submits exactly once.

Inspected .env.example, README.md, and .claude/CLAUDE.md: env coverage matches source reads, docs cover Supabase/Vercel setup, tag provisioning, race-day baseline refresh, rejoin, login lockout, and residual risks; current stack facts no longer describe db.json/SSE as active.
